# evm_signer_cli

> Headless approver for keystore_module: shows what a module asked to sign, in the keystore's own words, over `logosctl watch`, and takes the decision over `logosctl call`.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `status() -> tstr` | `{ ok, held, identity, approvers, custodians, rendered, pending_count, last_error, hint }`. |
| `list` | `list() -> tstr` | The keystore's queue summaries — never leg detail. |
| `show` | `show(handle: tstr) -> tstr` | Claim `handle` for display: the keystore's lines, verbatim, this signer's own reading of them, and the prompt text. |
| `approve` | `approve(handle: tstr, bundle_id: tstr, password: tstr) -> tstr` | The human said yes to the request on screen. |
| `reject` | `reject(handle: tstr) -> bool` | The human said no. |
| `refresh` | `refresh() -> tstr` | Re-read the queue now, then answer as `status` does. |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | `prompt(handle: tstr, text: tstr)` | A request is on screen. |
| `settled` | `settled(handle: tstr, state: tstr)` | `approved` ¦ `rejected` from the keystore; `gone` when the poll finds it vanished. |
| `queue_changed` | `queue_changed(count: int)` |  |
